name: asset-forge
description: Game-asset creation in Blender: a headless MCP server (Python standard library, no install) that renders review sets, validates, bakes and exports snapshots of the live scene, never the working .blend; a pure-bpy library of sculpt-like deforms, organic blockouts, stylized texture bakes, LODs, collision and retargeting; pipeline skills with per-engine presets; and an art-reviewer agent. Complements the Blender MCP server and the blender plugin's checkers.

blender_path.title: Blender executable (BLENDER_PATH)
blender_path.description: Full path to the Blender executable the headless server runs. Empty means: BLENDER_PATH from the environment, then blender on PATH, then the usual install folders.
